snippet.title: MoteMancer Announce Trailer!
snippet.description:
Automation meets Alchemy. Wishlist on Steam today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320980/

MoteMancer is a fantasy automation game where you harness the unique powers of Elemental tools, build alchemical systems, and cultivate discovery across six overlapping planes.

Craft structures. Infuse ingredients. Solve logistical puzzles on a living hex grid. There’s no single solution—build for efficiency, beauty, or elegance.
